comps.label: C1
comps.reason: Home medical equipment and supplies distributor billed to insurers; GoodRx is a consumer prescription savings and telehealth platform.

comps.label: C2
comps.reason: Generic injectable and inhalation drug manufacturer; GoodRx does not make drugs and sells no products.

comps.label: C3
comps.reason: B2B practice management and revenue cycle software for providers; GoodRx serves consumers and pharmacies with savings tools.

comps.label: C4
comps.reason: Free digital platform for clinicians monetized by pharma advertising and telehealth, closely mirroring GoodRx's model of consumer or clinician reach sold to drugmakers.

comps.label: C5
comps.reason: Insurance brokerage paid by carrier commissions; GoodRx earns from memberships, pharma fees and telehealth, not insurance sales.

comps.label: C6
comps.reason: Contract generic drug developer and manufacturer selling to pharma partners; GoodRx is a consumer platform, not a drug maker.

comps.label: C7
comps.reason: Vertical software and payments for small service businesses; different customers and no consumer prescription savings or pharma advertising.

comps.label: C8
comps.reason: Hospital workforce and credentialing software and surveys sold to providers; GoodRx sells consumer savings and pharma promotion.

comps.label: C9
comps.reason: Patient experience survey and benchmarking subscriptions sold to hospitals; GoodRx does not sell survey or analytics products to providers.

comps.label: C10
comps.reason: Diversified medical, dental and coding products and services for providers; GoodRx's consumer discount and telehealth model differs.

comps.label: C11
comps.reason: EHR and revenue cycle software for rural hospitals; GoodRx serves consumers and pharmacies, not hospital IT buyers.

comps.label: C12
comps.reason: Cloud software for life sciences commercial and regulatory operations; sells tools to drugmakers, not consumer savings or telehealth.

comps.label: C13
comps.reason: Supermarket chain with in-store pharmacy; GoodRx is a digital platform earning subscription, advertising and fee revenue.
